title: HMC Capital Group: Best Capital Markets Boutique, Latin America, 2014
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
HMC, with offices in Brazil, Peru and Colombia - as well as home country Chile – is very well placed to service client needs throughout Latin America.

And, according to the CFI.co Judging Panel, ‘HMC does so with skill and aplomb. Their quest for asset efficiency is well rewarded through the efforts of a talented and highly experienced team of financial services professionals. We are very happy to announce the win of this sub region award in the name of HMC Capital Group.’
